main_idea: BAR tests whether agents can complete end-to-end legal work, scored against standards.
ideas: Legal benchmark tests agents on end-to-end legal work
Tasks are scored against expert-shaped standards
BAR-informed harness changes raised output quality 5%
BAR has 5,161 cases across 28 practice areas
summary: Clutter from a slogan headline, a subtitle, decorative progress bars, footers, and a separate +5% product-impact callout and stats row; it lacks the model name, scores, and baseline for the 5% gain.

missing.why: Reader cannot tell which model or agent was evaluated or improved.
No performance values per model are shown, so the scoring result is absent.
The +5% lacks a before/after or baseline condition to compare against.
The unit and measure behind the 5% gain are not defined.
